title: Unit Event — With Our Wounded Hands — Episode8 Friends

meta.Event Outline: Ena hasn't been able to reach Mizuki since the school festival. She doesn't know what the right thing to do is, but her regrets compel her to seek Mizuki out for a heart-to-heart.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Please...!
Talk to me... Just for a little bit...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ever since that day, I haven't been able to stop thinking...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Not since you vanished.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I keep asking myself what I could've said instead or how I really should've reacted. I keep wondering if you wouldn't have run away if I had...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I keep wondering what I could've done better...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: To be honest, I don't even know if confronting you here like this is the best option...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I know you don't want me thinking about what's right or wrong or whatever... I get that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But... But...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I want us to stay friends!
Which means it's natural that I'd want to make the right choice!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You know how I am...!
Once I regret something, I dwell on it forever!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I understand that my way of doing things could end up hurting you even more! But... But...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm doing this because I still want us to be friends moving forward...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You've gotta at least know that!!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Please, stop.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's just end it here...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, you're already having trouble dealing with what you've learned...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Moving forward, you're gonna worry and not know how to talk to me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So I think being around me isn't such a good idea...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No...!
I'm not about to end things here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You don't want to either, right?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You've stopped running and avoiding me, which tells me that you don't want things to end here...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't want us to go our separate ways...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If something I'm doing is causing you harm, then I'll do my best to stop.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know that makes you feel like you're being pitied...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But I don't want to hurt you.
That's the clear and honest truth!
That's never ever going to change!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because you're my dear friend, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wh-Why...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Why are you able to say that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Don't you know that being my friend means having to tiptoe around a lot of stuff...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You might see people looking at me funny... People who we don't know at all might begin spreading nasty rumors about us...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What happens then, Ena...?
Are you still going to treat me the same...?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Because even though I can't bear to, I would be looking at your reaction every time!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If we end it here, you won't have to worry about that! I mean, Ena, you...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't care what happens to me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't care what other people say or how hard it's going to be to deal with all this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because never seeing you again would hurt more!!!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But...! But...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I do care!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't know if I'll be able to accept the kindness you and the others are going to give me at face value...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And it's gonna turn into a never-ending cycle...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm sick and tired of feeling this pain...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's going to hurt every time you all try to be nice to me...! I'll keep thinking why it has to be like this...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm going to wonder, “Is it even okay for us to keep being friends?” I know I am...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And if us staying friends means having to suffer...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then...!
We should just say goodbye to each other now!
se_event_scratch_2024_004

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What are you talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you mean, “Is it okay for us to keep being friends”...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm saying...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're wrong...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm saying you're wrong about wondering if it's okay for us to be friends, because that question doesn't make any sense to begin with!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Have you been listening?! I still consider you my friend! Or do you mean you don't think of me as yours?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, if we really still are friends, then don't make decisions for me by yourself...!!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Get it through your thick skull, will you...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Between that day and now, I've thought long and hard about what you're going through! I even learned a few new things along the way!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But my feelings haven't changed!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're the one who's changed, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I've been trying to talk to you, but you haven't been listening...! You've just been running away...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And you're seriously wondering if it's okay for us to keep being friends?! To me, that sounds really stupid because...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You have been and always will be my dear friend!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is that at least getting through to you?!
se_event_scratch_2024_005

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My feelings haven't changed...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was surprised, but even so, it's the absolute truth...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's everything I wanted to say...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If you still feel like leaving, then I'm not gonna stop you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because that's probably what'll make you the happiest...
se_event_scratch_2024_006

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena...
So weird...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Run if that is what you really want to do.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <But this may be your last chance to talk to everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What am I supposed to do...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is it really okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: ...for me to be friends with all of you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm going to get scared again...
I'm going to want to run away...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know it's going to happen...!
I'm going to be backed into a corner!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want to feel like I belong...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I still want us to be friends...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's all I've ever wanted...!
Friends who accept me for who I am...! Friends who feel comfortable around me...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But no matter how hard I tried, I just couldn't tell you...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I'm not sure things will ever get better...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is it really okay for someone like me...to still be friends with you?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Again, your question doesn't make any sense.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You have to decide for yourself, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because... I really don't wanna have to chase after you like this again.
se_event_scratch_2024_003

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Stammer*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm gonna cause you a lot of trouble...!
I might end up having really bad days...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I wanna stay...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I wanna keep belonging...! I want us to stay friends...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's stay together, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: N25's been waiting for you to come back.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Cry*
se_event_scratch_2024_007

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Welcome back, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry for making you all worry.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm alright now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also... Um...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There's something I need to tell all of you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Something you guys have to hear...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Something I've been wanting to say.

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: 05_night_ed3
